data.one_liner: A library to parse and work with multiple subtitle and caption file formats like WebVTT and SRT.
data.what_it_does: It fetches, parses, and manages subtitle formats including WebVTT, SRT, TTML, and DFXP. It provides controllers for searching subtitles by duration, deduplicating cues, and handling encoding fallbacks.
use_when: You need to display or synchronize subtitles in a video player app.
You want to parse local, network, asset, or raw string subtitle files.
avoid_when: You are building a backend application that does not deal with caption files.
strengths: Supports multiple popular formats (WebVTT, SRT, TTML, DFXP).
High-performance line-based parsing and O(log n + k) multi-cue search.
Built-in automatic cue deduplication and encoding fallback.
weaknesses: Limited to subtitle parsing and management rather than a full built-in video rendering player widget.
